label: Weak-field low-velocity limit

attrs.description: The regime where gravitational fields are weak and velocities are much smaller than the speed of light, so spacetime curvature can be treated as a small perturbation on flat space.

review: Was the assumption "weak-field low-velocity limit" on relation e13 (Einstein Field Equations leads to Newtonian Gravity) until 2026-10, when assumptions became concepts; it's now in the "assumes" of Einstein Field Equations, the relation's source. Type, importance and generality are placeholders — Sophie to check them, and that Einstein Field Equations is the concept that assumes it.
